snippet.title: FNAFMIN - F3 2025 Trailer (Pikmin 2 RomHack)
snippet.description:
The official trailer for JaySalty's Pikmin 2 mod FNAFMIN that was featured in @KazeN64 's 2025 F3 presentation.

This mod is a recreation of Five Nights at Freddy's built into the Pikmin 2 engine using the Pikmin 2 Decomp.

#pikmin #pikmin2 #modding #romhack #romhacks #romhacking #f3
